title: Avoiding every geometric affine sequence in a large-measure set
exact_target: For every $q\in(0,1)$ and $\eta\in(0,1)$, does some compact $E\subset[0,1]$ of Lebesgue measure greater than $1-\eta$ avoid containing $\{a+bq^n:n\geq1\}$ for every real $a$ and every nonzero real $b$ of either sign?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
